### Character
A small adorable white 3D duck mascot named Todeogi stands on the right side of a wide grassy hillside, holding a white flag with the original blue emblem.

Todeogi has a smooth round white head, a small rounded white body, two black oval eyes, a yellow oval beak, a small light-gray rectangular cap, two short rounded wings, and two short gray feet.

Its appearance, proportions, facial features, silhouette, and soft matte 3D material remain fully consistent with the first frame.

Only one Todeogi character exists in the entire shot.

### Background
A peaceful grassy hill with one large green tree slightly left of center, beneath a beautiful blue sky with delicate textured clouds.

The original landscape composition, tree position, horizon, sky layout, and perspective remain unchanged throughout the entire video.

### Prop
Todeogi holds the white flag securely with one wing.

The flagpole remains straight and rigid.

The white flag keeps its original blue emblem and flutters softly in the breeze without changing shape excessively.

### Action
Todeogi performs a calm and gentle sequence of movement while staying within a small area of the foreground.

It takes a few small natural steps on the grass, shifts its body weight subtly, and occasionally raises its free wing in a gentle greeting.

Its motion remains slow, deliberate, physically balanced, and emotionally calm.

It returns naturally to a relaxed upright standing posture while continuing to hold the flag.

The mascot never runs wildly, never jumps suddenly, and never makes exaggerated gestures.

### Motion Consistency
The animation is one uninterrupted physical performance.

Every consecutive frame maintains smooth continuity of position, pose, scale, orientation, and body structure.

Todeogi changes position only gradually through small natural steps.

Its body remains firm and stable, with subtle natural motion rather than rubbery or exaggerated deformation.

Its feet maintain realistic contact with the ground.

Its body size remains constant relative to the scene.

Its face, beak, cap, feet, and wings remain visually stable and recognizable in every frame.

There are no abrupt changes in posture, no sudden resets, and no repeated loop-like restart feeling.

### Background Motion
A gentle breeze softly moves the outer leaves and small branches of the large tree.

The grass sways very subtly.

The tree trunk, hill, horizon, and overall scenery remain visually stable.

### Camera
A completely locked-off wide tripod shot.

The camera never moves, zooms, tracks, pans, tilts, rotates, pushes in, or changes perspective.

The large tree, horizon, and framing remain fixed from start to finish.

### Lighting
Consistent natural daylight with soft outdoor shadows and stable color temperature.

Lighting remains even and coherent across the entire clip.

### Style
High-quality soft matte 3D mascot animation integrated into a photorealistic grassy landscape.

Natural, calm, and continuous movement.

Stable proportions, clean character anatomy, coherent flag motion, subtle environmental movement, and smooth temporal consistency.

A peaceful sightseeing atmosphere.

One continuous uninterrupted 15-second shot with no scene transition or action reset.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: Egyptian royal in blue-and-gold headdress and high collar, white dress with golden embroidery and armbands, desert, robot soldiers in formation left and right. She walks steadily forward, head held level and gaze fixed ahead—no dipping or lowering of the head. The camera performs a single, smooth push-in only: starting in a wider shot of her, the robots, and the desert, it moves steadily forward until she is in a medium or medium-close frame, then holds. She stops, posture and head still upright, and says: “The old gods are silent. I am not.” Robot soldiers shift or march in place; sand and fabric move with the wind. No pull-back; the only camera move is the continuous push-in.
